Subject: Kickoff: vendor sustainability declaration & procurement setup - GreenArc Supplies

Hi Sabrina,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference as GreenArc's inference partner — excited to get the procurement paperwork sorted quickly so we can start the dedicated onboarding.

To keep things moving, could you please complete and return the items in the attached procurement_onboarding_checklist.pdf by end of next week (Apr 9)? Key asks for our side:
- Supplier Diversity / ESG questionnaire (we'll need a signed sustainability declaration + Self-ID for diversity status)
- W-9 or relevant tax form (for US vendors)
- Bank details for ACH (or notify if you prefer secure portal)
- Certificate of Insurance (if applicable)
- Primary PO contact and billing email

I've also shared a short Drive folder with the checklist and sample PO terms: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bOnboardingChecklist.

Internal next steps: Laura will drive vendor setup in our ERP; Monica will review any contractual language flagged under modern slavery / ESG clauses. If you have a preferred procurement contact at GreenArc, please share — otherwise we'll add the email above as the primary contact.

Thanks — if it helps, we can do a quick 15-min call to walk the forms.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Business Development Manager | Redwood Inference

Laura/Monica — forwarding GreenArc's initial reply and docs. Quick summary and asks:

Summary: GreenArc attached their supplier profile and COI; they will provide the diversity self-ID and signed sustainability declaration. Jenna Park will be the procurement lead.

Action items:
- Laura: please initiate vendor record in our ERP (NetLedger) and issue a vendor portal invite. Required fields: legal name, tax ID, remit-to, primary PO contact (jenna.park@greenarc.com). I have attached a blank vendor_setup_form.csv for your reference.
- Laura: confirm whether we need a completed W-9 before issuing a PO to test billing.
- Monica: please review GreenArc's supplier profile and advise on whether their proposed modern slavery clause (they said they can provide their standard clause) is acceptable. If not, we should send Redwood's standard clause to expedite.

Goal timeline: vendor in ERP + signed sustainability docs by Apr 9 so we can issue first PO on Apr 12. If legal review will take longer, please flag.

If anyone wants to jump on a 20-min call to align, I can host.

Thanks,
Rishi

Thanks Rishi — looping in process steps so GreenArc knows what to expect.

Procurement onboarding steps (what we'll do):
1) Create vendor record in ERP (NetLedger) — fields to populate: legal name, tax ID/EIN, remit-to address, primary billing contact, PO email.
2) Send secure vendor portal invite (for banking details) — we prefer bank details via portal; bank letter is acceptable but slower.
3) Request W-9 before first invoice is processed (US vendors).
4) Attach COI to vendor record.
5) Confirm diversity self-ID and signed sustainability declaration; we'll store in compliance folder and flag if further follow-up needed.

Sabrina/Jenna — please upload W-9 and supplier_diversity_self-id.pdf to the portal link we will send. Expect the portal invite within today.

Monica — for the modern slavery clause, please see our standard clause excerpt below. If GreenArc prefers to propose theirs, ask them to send redlines.

[Redwood standard modern slavery clause excerpt]
"Supplier warrants that it has complied with all applicable modern slavery and human trafficking laws and has implemented adequate policies to prevent forced labor in its operations and supply chain."

I will proceed with vendor creation once I have: legal name, EIN, remit-to, and COI.

Laura Bennett
